experiment: Stage 13B historical and hypothetical portfolio stress scenarios

portfolio.name: ^NSEI single-asset index proxy
portfolio.scope_note: Only a single NIFTY 50 index holding is available; this is an index proxy, not a diversified portfolio.
portfolio.assumptions: Fully invested, long-only, buy-and-hold weights; no fees, cash flows, leverage, or rebalancing.
portfolio.valuation_formula: stressed_value = starting_value * sum(weight_i * (1 + simple_return_i)); loss = starting_value - stressed_value; asset contribution_i = -starting_value * weight_i * simple_return_i

historical_scenarios.input: decimal log returns from the existing ReturnSeries
historical_scenarios.window_policy: all overlapping consecutive observation windows; retain the worst losses
historical_scenarios.gap_policy: gap-spanning observations are included and flagged in each scenario row

hypothetical_scenarios.scope: portfolio-wide; the same shock is applied to every holding (currently one index proxy)
